text:
arz: Quick sanity check — after the flashv3 kernel rollout to sa-east-1 (H100 pool) we see p95 regressions vs us-east-1. Anyone else observing this? :thinking_face:
maria: Can you paste the numbers and the model + quant config?
arz: Posted the run summary from the synthetic latency sweep (same model, no quantization, batch=1):
```
region       | gpu  | kernel    | p50  | p95  | qps
us-east-1    | H100 | flashv2   | 11ms | 38ms | 185
sa-east-1    | H100 | flashv3   | 14ms | 72ms | 138
us-west-2    | A100 | flashv3   | 13ms | 45ms | 160
sa-east-1    | A100 | flashv2   | 15ms | 48ms | 150
```
sam: Interesting — sa-east-1 H100 looks worse only with flashv3. A100s don't regress as much. Could be host-side differences (PCIe lanes, CPU-cpu affinity) or firmware/driver combo in that AZ.
ci-bot: perf run results uploaded: https://perf.redwood/internal/runs/1953456789 (contains raw traces + flamegraphs) :chart_with_upwards_trend:
devon: From past experience, newer attention kernels (flashv3) move more work onto warp-level memory access patterns which are sensitive to NVLINK topology and driver distribution. If the SA H100 hosts have different NVLINK configuration or older driver, p95 can spike. We should check host kernel/driver.
maria: Also double-check power/thermal policy for those instances — São Paulo hosts historically had slightly different power profiles in our provider region. Even thermal throttling shows up mostly at p95.
sam: Short-term mitigation: enable per-region kernel heuristic and fallback to flashv2 for sa-east-1 H100 until we confirm root cause. I'd add a metric-based trigger: fallback when p95 > 1.5x baseline OR p95 increase sustained for 3 mins.
devon: Proposed policy snippet (for rollout):
```
kernel_policy:
  - match: { region: sa-east-1, gpu: H100 }
    prefer: flashv2
    fallback_trigger: "p95 > baseline*1.5 for 3m"
  - global_fallback: triton_vendor
```
maria: Note that quantized q8 runs sometimes flip the balance — flashv3 can be better for q8 on H100 because kernel fusion changes. We should run a small q8 sweep as well before locking policy.
arz: I'll kick off a q8 sweep and a driver/firmware audit for the sa-east-1 H100 fleet. Will post results here. For the rollout I agree with safe fallback to flashv2 for that region.
sam: FYI, if fallback isn't enough we can also route critical low-latency traffic to us-east-1 with traffic-aware routing while we investigate.
arz: Thanks — creating a tiny canary with the kernel policy now. Will update when the q8 sweep and the audit complete. :thumbsup:
